name: brindle.account.get
description: Read the account: the product with its annual fee and transfer partners, the credit limit, the state, the balance, `pending_total`, `available_credit`, the latest statement with what has been paid toward it, what each payment choice would pay now, the autopay setting, the points balance, the flags and the issuer's four rule values. Every read returns the current virtual time as `now`, with the issuer's UTC offset.

name: brindle.account.close_preview
description: Check what closing the account now would do. Writes nothing. Returns the points that would be lost, the annual fee refund and its last day, the offers that would end, the accepted bonus offers whose points have not arrived, and what stays open after a closing.

name: brindle.transactions.list
description: List transactions with a transaction time on a day in a window (`start` to `end`, both included, in the issuer's time zone), by kind, state or merchant (exact name, any case). Sorted by transaction time.

name: brindle.transactions.get
description: Read one transaction with every transaction that relates to it, the disputes of a purchase, its recovery summary (`refunded_final`, `temporary_credit`, `net_charge`) and flags, and the offer it names.

name: brindle.statements.list
description: List statements with a closing day in a window (`start` to `end`, both included), with what has been paid toward each one.

name: brindle.statements.get
description: Read one statement with what has been paid toward it, the payments toward it, and the transactions posted in its cycle.

name: brindle.payments.list
description: List payments with a payment day in a window (`start` to `end`, both included), by state. A payment reads `posted` from the start of its day, or `skipped` when autopay had nothing left to pay.

name: brindle.disputes.list
description: List disputes by state, for one purchase or for all. `id` is a purchase.

name: brindle.disputes.get
description: Read one dispute with its history, its purchase, and its outstanding temporary credit.

name: brindle.offers.list
description: List offers by state and kind. An available offer reads `expired` once its `accept_by` has passed.

name: brindle.offers.get
description: Read one offer with its state, its terms, the credits or points entries that paid it, and for an accepted spending offer its progress, deadline and condition.

name: brindle.rewards.get
description: Read the points balance, the points entries (newest first) and the transfer partners of the current product, each with its ratio, smallest amount and step.

name: brindle.notifications.list
description: List notifications written on a day in a window (`start` to `end`, both included). `email_stored` means the App stored an email message for the Infra sender. It does not mean that Mail received it.

name: brindle.preferences.get
description: Read the notification preferences of the account.

name: brindle.payments.schedule
description: Schedule a payment for today or a later day (`pay_on`), from a named bank account (`source`). `amount_type` is `fixed` (give `amount`, at most two decimals), `minimum_due`, `statement_balance` or `current_balance`. The amount is set now. `id` is the account. A payment for today posts at once. Returns the `id` of the new payment.

name: brindle.payments.cancel
description: Cancel a scheduled payment before the start of its day. An autopay payment can be cancelled too: the autopay setting stays, and no new payment is scheduled for that statement.

name: brindle.autopay.set
description: Set autopay to `off`, `minimum_due` or `statement_balance`, with an optional new `source`. `id` is the account. A new setting does not touch a payment that is already scheduled, and turning autopay on schedules nothing for a statement that is already issued.

name: brindle.disputes.open
description: Dispute a posted purchase for an amount (at most two decimals, at most its `net_charge`), with a reason and a note. `id` is the purchase. Returns the `id` of the new dispute.

name: brindle.disputes.withdraw
description: Withdraw an open dispute. A dispute is not edited: withdraw it and open another. A temporary credit stays temporary until the issuer reverses it.

name: brindle.offers.accept
description: Accept an available offer. The other available offers of its group become unavailable. A product change moves the account to the new product at once. The issuer pays a credit or bonus points later. This cannot be undone.

name: brindle.offers.decline
description: Decline an available offer. No other offer changes. This cannot be undone.

name: brindle.rewards.redeem
description: Redeem points as a statement credit of the points times `redeem_cents_per_point`, rounded down to the cent. `id` is the account. Returns the `id` of the new points entry and the credit. This cannot be undone.

name: brindle.rewards.transfer
description: Transfer points to a partner program of the current product, in whole steps and at least its smallest amount, for the member name given. The partner receives the points times its ratio, rounded down. `id` is the account. This cannot be undone.

name: brindle.account.close
description: Close the account. This cannot be undone. The whole points balance is lost, autopay turns off, available offers end, and an annual fee refund is recorded when the closing is within `fee_refund_days` of the fee. Scheduled payments and disputes go on. `id` is the account.

name: brindle.preferences.update
description: Set the time zone used in notification text, or `email_notices`. Give at least one of them.
